name: Elevate (City of Austin ACME FY27)
summary: City of Austin funding for arts organizations, individual artists, and creative businesses producing public art. KUT reported about $11 million.
who: Arts organizations, individual artists, and creative businesses producing public art
18 or older
Live or based in the Austin-Round Rock MSA for the grant term
Public activities in Austin or the ETJ; HOT tourism rules apply
One application per program per applicant entity
Not a full-time City of Austin / ACME employee
amount: About $11 million in total (as reported by KUT)
timing_note: The FY27 round closed 6:59pm on August 18, 2026. Late applications were not accepted.
how_to_apply: Complete the Universal Program Eligibility Form, then the program application. Portal help: ApplicationHelp@thelongcenter.org. Program questions: CulturalArts@AustinTexas.gov. Office hours Tuesdays 10am-noon.

name: Austin Live Music Fund (City of Austin ACME FY27)
summary: A $6 million City of Austin fund for professional musicians, independent promoters, and live music venues.
who: Must meet the Professional Musician, Independent Promoter, or Live Music Venue definition on the program page
Live Music Venue: a minimum $60,000 operating budget
Universal program notes apply: 18 or older, Austin-Round Rock MSA, one application per program per applicant entity
amount: $6 million in total. Professional Musician and Independent Promoter: $20,000 over 24 months or $5,000 over 12 months. Live Music Venue: $70,000 over 12 months.
timing_note: The FY27 round closed 6:59pm on August 18, 2026. Late applications were not accepted.
how_to_apply: Complete the Universal Program Eligibility Form, then the program application. Program questions: CulturalArts@AustinTexas.gov.

name: HAAM (Health Alliance for Austin Musicians)
summary: Health care help for Austin's working musicians: premium assistance, primary care, dental, vision, hearing, mind and body, fitness, and healthcare navigation.
who: Working musician, music teacher, or DJ (part or full time)
Lives in Travis or surrounding counties
Annual tax household income at or below 400% of the federal poverty level (self-employed: net after expenses)
Proof of music work in the last 12 months (gigs, releases, teaching, and similar). HAAM says apply anyway if unsure.
timing_note: People can join year-round. Open enrollment for insurance help is November 1 to December 15.
how_to_apply: Request an application on the join page. Contact: 512-541-4226 option 2, support@myhaam.org.

name: Texas Workforce Commission (TWC)
summary: The state labor agency: unemployment, workforce solutions, training, and benefits for people with uneven work. Someone with a few gigs plus a retail job can still ask.
who: People with uneven work. Specific benefit amounts and eligibility come from TWC and local Workforce Solutions offices.
how_to_apply: Contact TWC or a local Workforce Solutions office. The starter list does not include benefit amounts.

name: Texas Commission on the Arts (TCA)

who: See the guidelines for each TCA program.
timing_note: The starter list has no current open cycle. Check the TCA calendar.
